meta.re_freeze_reason: THE root regime-gate fix (PKT-TRADER-BOT-REGIME-GATE-FIX-AND-LINE-RESEED-V1-20260708 / CL-708110), operator-authorized. The 2026-06-23 re-freeze restored regime as a SOFT per-name multiplier (regime_score_mult) but left theta_sel.regime_admissibility EMPTY {} — so the two-stage's ONLY hard SET-rotation control (engine/selection.py::_regime_admits) never gated: an empty map admits all asset_classes. A soft multiplier mathematically cannot rotate the book because bonds carry negative mu (high_vol_panic tech mu*0.40 still outranks TLT (-mu)*1.25), so canon held a ~half-growth book through every panic (proven on the real 2026-06-24 panic: pre-fix held ARKK/FXI/SMH/SOXX/XLC/XLK = 6/10 equity). This re-freeze POPULATES theta_sel.regime_admissibility (theta_sel content_hash moves f154f3ce->385571b3) so regime hard-gates the eligible SET in high_vol_panic; mu then ranks WITHIN the admissible set (the two-stage finally 'picking the regime first'). NO engine .py changed (engine_sha unchanged 4ae7b79d); NO mu down-weighting (mu IC~0 is a separate logged issue); NO freshness/abort gate weakened; theta_size unchanged. Per the no-mid-stream bound (LIVE_PREREG.md §3) this terminates the prior LIVE_PREREG reads and opens a fresh forward pre-registration with start date 2026-07-09.

provenance.regime_admissibility: {"high_vol_panic": ["bond", "commodity", "fx", "vol"]} (POPULATED 2026-07-08, CL-708110 root fix). The regime label now hard-gates the Stage-1 eligible SET (engine/selection.py::_regime_admits: a symbol is admissible iff its asset_class is in the regime's admit-list; a regime ABSENT from the map admits all). DERIVATION (packet-mandated, not hand-invented): for each regime label in the SHARED config/regime_compatibility.json, admit the COARSE asset_classes {equity,bond,commodity,vol,fx} whose regime multiplier is >= a justified cutoff of 0.60 and exclude the knocked-down ones. The gate reads f.asset_class, which universe.csv populates at the COARSE granularity (equity/bond/commodity/vol/fx); the fine sector granularity (sector_tech, treas_long, ...) lives in the separate 'sector' column that the ForecastBundle does not carry, so admissibility is derived at the coarse level — consistent with the challenger's own panic filter (challenger/incumbent.py: asset_class.isin(['bond','commodity'])). Cutoff 0.60 sits in the wide gap between the sole coarse class the config knocks into the exclusion zone (high_vol_panic equity 0.50) and the next-lowest coarse value across all regimes (0.85), so ONLY high_vol_panic populates: it EXCLUDES equity (0.50) and ADMITS bond (1.20) / commodity (1.10) / vol (1.30) / fx (0.90). Every other regime's lowest coarse value is >= 0.85 (>0.60) so all classes admit -> those regimes are ABSENT from the map (admit-all), and their milder de-risk is handled by the soft regime_score_mult + Stage-2 regime_exposure_multiplier, exactly as the challenger operates outside panic. This value MOVES the content_hash (f154f3ce->385571b3); mu (regime_score_mult) and theta_size are unchanged.
